newsitem.title: INDIA: India gold ends steady, silver up, off day's highs.
newsitem.headline: India gold ends steady, silver up, off day's highs.

text.p: ** Gold 24 carat ends steady at 4,600 rupees per 10 gramme, sluggish physical demand trims early gains towards close
** Gold biscuits (116.50 gramme each) end steady at 53,800 rupees per piece
** Silver (.999) ends 15 rupees higher at 6,750 rupees per kg, profit-taking by stockists drags prices down after a firm start.

Gold 24 carat ended Tuesday at 4,600 rupees per 10 gramme, unchanged from Monday's close but down 5 rupees from the opening 4,605 rupees as fresh arrivals dragged prices down after a firm start, dealers said.
They said gold opened higher on the back of a recovery in the world market but sluggish physical buying later in the day trimmed early gains towards close.
Prices of gold biscuits ended steady at 53,800 rupees per piece but down 100 rupees from the opening 53,900 rupees per piece. They were down 50 rupees on Monday.
Silver (.999) ended at 6,750 rupees, 15 rupees higher from Monday's close but down 20 rupees from the opening as fresh arrivals trimmed early gains towards close, dealers said.
Silver was down 25 rupees per kg on Monday.
Dealers said overall market sentiment was subdued at the close of the session on limited physical enquiries.
